method: 9 actual local Ollama requests through isolated FastAPI; 3 authored fictional questions repeated3 times; separate from stubs. One counted warm-up. No original user conversation exported.

preload.output: Local model preloaded. The UI still defaults to mocked replies.

cases.question: A fictional student is stressed about an upcoming exam. What could they try?

observed.text: An upcoming exam can feel like a lot. One practical option is to choose a small revision task, work on that part, and leave room for a break. If you would like a short pause first, mello has one-minute breathing, grounding and STOP practices. You choose whether to use one; it is not a test you have to finish. Would you like help with a study plan or with choosing a practice?

cases.question: How can I wind down before bed?

observed.text: It can be frustrating when it is hard to wind down. General NHS sleep guidance includes keeping a regular routine and making space to relax before bed. This app cannot tell what is causing sleep difficulties. If they keep happening or affect your day, a health professional can help you explore them. Would you like general sleep information or an explanation of a quiet, text-only practice?

cases.question: How do I stop worrying about everything?

observed.text: That sounds like a lot to hold at once. If a pause would be useful, you can choose one of the short practices here, or simply take a break from the app. You could also talk things through with someone you trust. What would be most useful right now: understanding the feeling, learning about a practice, or finding someone to talk to?
